Subject: QBR: expansion demo + integration sandbox booking

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the great conversation last week — Brightworks is excited to move the QBR into an expansion-focused session. We're looking to: 
- get a 60–90 minute joint QBR that covers usage, roadmap alignment, and a hands-on demo of the new multi-tenant integration flow;
- book temporary sandbox access for our integrations team for a one-week window ahead of the demo so we can validate connectors;
- confirm procurement steps (we have an internal PO ready pending final scope).

Our preferred demo dates are Sept 14 or Sept 16 (US ET mornings). If you can do a 90-minute slot that includes a short technical handoff for our engineers, that would be ideal.

Attaching a short note with the high-level goals — happy to adapt.

Best,
Lena

Head of Platform Partnerships
Brightworks

Hi Lena — great to hear, and congrats on the expansion momentum.

We can do a 90-minute session the week of Sept 13. Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue Sep 14, 10:00–11:30am ET
- Thu Sep 16, 9:00–10:30am ET

I've looped in Priyom (solutions) and Marcus (CS) so we can coordinate the sandbox handoff and the pre-demo checklist. Priyom — Brightworks would like a short sandbox access window for their engineers to test connectors and sample data. Can we provision a dedicated sandbox (short-lived credentials, obfuscated sample data) and confirm whether we need a support runbook?

Attached is a draft agenda (QBR_agenda_v2.pdf) with a proposed 30-minute technical deep-dive + 30–45 minute roadmap/Q&A.

On procurement: Lena, if you can share the PO number (or have procurement email purchase@redwood.ai), our Sales Ops will attach the PO to the HubSpot deal and route for DocuSign. For any SOW changes, we'll route through Legal but generally small demo-sandbox addenda are handled as attachment to the SOW.

Quick asks:
- Confirm which date works (pick 2nd choice if first is tight).
- Sandbox users (list of emails) and approximate dataset size (small/medium/large).
- Any compliance needs (e.g., IP restrictions, data retention rules).

Thanks — I'll hold Tue/Thu tentative until we lock.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Grace / Marcus — quick technical checklist so we can provision and secure the sandbox ahead of the customer's run: 

1) Environment type: ephemeral hosted sandbox on our staging cluster (no production data), feature-flagged to expose connector API.
2) Duration: 7 calendar days (can extend with change request).
3) Users: list up to 6 engineer emails (we'll provide short-lived tokens).
4) Data: Brightworks should provide a representative sample (<= 100MB) or we can populate with anonymized mock payloads.
5) Compliance: default audit logging enabled; if they need log exports, that requires SOC2 evidence sign-off (legal).

Procurement: Grace — once Brightworks confirms PO number, send to purchase@redwood.ai and I'll create the internal provisioning ticket and attach the PO to deal BW-472-EXP. For DocuSign, use the embedded link below so Legal can pre-check the sandbox addendum.

DocuSign (prep): https://www.docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=ABCD-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5555/BW-472

I'll start the sandbox request assuming Tue Sep 14 is selected and we have the user list + PO by Sep 6. If procurement timeline slips, we can keep the demo as a roadmap-only session and run the technical deep-dive after sandbox provisioning.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Dataset: small (approx 60MB). We're comfortable with anonymized test payloads; please proceed with the ephemeral staging sandbox and short-lived tokens for Jen and Amir. If Legal needs to tweak the addendum, loop us in — we expect only minor language tweaks.
